# Video { #anylumino.Video }

```python
Video(
    value='',
    format='mp4',
    width='',
    height='',
)
```

Video display widget.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type     | Description                                              | Default   |
|--------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `''` |
| format | optional | Media format such as ``'png'``, ``'mp3'``, or ``'mp4'``. | `'mp4'` |
| width | optional | CSS width for media widgets. | `''` |
| height | optional | CSS height for media widgets. | `''` |

| --- | --- |
